definitions.explanation: The process of returning something to a normal or proper state. Commonly used in diplomacy (normalizing relations), economics (normalizing policy), and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}の{関係|かんけい}{正常化|せいじょうか}が{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: The normalization of relations between the two countries progressed.

examples.japanese: {事態|じたい}の{正常化|せいじょうか}に{向|む}けて{努力|どりょく}する。
examples.english: We will make efforts toward normalizing the situation.

examples.japanese: ストライキが{終|お}わり、{運行|うんこう}ダイヤが{正常化|せいじょうか}された。
examples.english: The strike ended and the train schedule was restored to normal.

notes:
Composed of {正常|せいじょう} (normal, proper) and {化|か} (-ization suffix). A formal word frequently used in news and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関係|かんけい}の{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of relations
- {国交|こっこう}{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of diplomatic relations
- {金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}の{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of monetary policy
- {事態|じたい}の{正常化|せいじょうか}: normalization of the situation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回復|かいふく}: recovery — returning to a previous good state
- {安定化|あんていか}: stabilization — becoming stable
- {正常|せいじょう}に{戻|もど}る: to return to normal — more conversational expression
